# Bohdan Moroz

> Bohdan Moroz — software engineer working in applied AI. Four years building production web and mobile apps for US logistics, HR, and fintech teams. Open to freelance work.

Bohdan Moroz is a full-stack TypeScript engineer based in Sofia, Bulgaria. He focuses on agentic AI workflows and end-to-end delivery for US small and mid-size businesses in logistics (TMS), HR onboarding, and fintech. He ships across the stack — React and Next.js on the web, React Native (Expo) on mobile, NestJS/Fastify/Express on the server — with CI/CD, Docker, and self-hosted infrastructure as defaults. Where AI workloads can't ship traffic to OpenAI or Anthropic, he runs self-hosted models via Ollama, vLLM, and LiteLLM.

He is open to freelance work, remote or in person in Sofia. The fastest way to reach him is email: contact@bohdanmoroz.com.

## Selected work

- [ClaraHR](https://clarahr.io): Onboarding system for US truck drivers — a chat bot interviews them on whichever channel they prefer and files them in the carrier's system, replacing manual HR back-and-forth. Lead dev on the server side. Fastify · Next.js · Postgres · Sequelize · Redis · BullMQ · Socket.IO · Twilio · Telegram · Resend · AWS S3 · OpenAI · Docker Swarm · Vitest. 8 carriers · 635 drivers onboarded. 2025 → present.
- [CargoHub](https://map.cargoetl.com) (live): Public freight marketplace where US shippers and brokers browse partner carriers' trucks, post loads, and book capacity directly. An in-product AI assistant handles routine booking and dispatch steps; accounts, live tracking, and document flow are built in. Sole developer. Next.js · Postgres · Prisma · NextAuth · Google Maps · Resend · Zustand · Zod · SWR · MUI · OpenAI · DeepSeek · Playwright. 9 carriers · ~2,500 trucks. 2026 → present.
- CargoFinance: Accounting and light-fintech tooling for a logistics back-office — invoicing, transfer tracking, payouts via bank rails. Focused on turning an unfamiliar domain (AP/AR, reconciliation) into something operators actually use. Sole developer. Nest.js · Vite · Postgres · Prisma · TanStack Router · TanStack Query · Tailwind · Radix · Plaid · Zod · Vitest · Playwright · MSW. 2026 → present.
- [CargoETL](https://cargoetl.com): Closed TMS platform for US logistics carriers and dispatchers. Built and maintains both ends: the Next.js dispatcher dashboard and the React Native (Expo) driver app — order flow, live tracking, documents, and dispatch comms. Web: Next.js · Ant Design · MobX · Autobahn (WebSocket) · Google Maps · Sentry · TinyMCE. Mobile: React Native · Expo · Redux Toolkit · Zustand · Reanimated · React Native Maps · Firebase Messaging · Notifee · Sentry · Google Places. 2024 → present.
- [Altek TMS](https://altek.digital): Earlier TMS for US logistics carriers and dispatchers — dispatcher dashboard plus driver app, covering order flow, live tracking, and dispatch comms. First multi-year production project; the service has since wound down. Vue · Nuxt · JavaScript · React Native. 2022 → 2024.

## How he works

- End-to-end ownership: takes a feature from a half-formed Figma or a paragraph of requirements all the way through frontend, backend, infrastructure, and deploy — without needing handoffs along the way.
- TypeScript across the stack: React / Next.js on the web, React Native (Expo) on mobile, NestJS/Fastify/Express on the server. CI/CD, testing, Docker by default; self-host infra when it makes sense, AWS / Vercel / Hetzner when it doesn't.
- Agentic AI is core to how he works — built his own tooling around it, so agents handle the typing while he drives architecture, review, and integration. Can also set up and run the infrastructure itself — self-hosted inference, gateways, routing. Net effect: meaningfully more shipped per week than a hands-on-keyboard pace.
- Async-friendly and used to working with US clients from Sofia, Bulgaria (UTC+2). Works in English, Ukrainian, and Russian.
